description: Read the current caller’s shared daily REST/MCP quota without consuming a call or creating a usage record. Use before a batch of processing/upload calls or after quota exhaustion to learn when to retry. This does not inspect, process, upload, or delete JSON. Takes no arguments: the server uses the request IP, or the UUID bearer token configured in the MCP client Authorization header. Do not pass credentials as tool arguments. Free-tier results contain success, tier (anonymous or uuid), limit, used, remaining, and reset_at (next midnight UTC). Limits are 100 calls per IP or 1,000 per UUID. Uploads and jq processing share this counter; metadata checks, deletion, and discovery are free. Active prepaid access returns tier:paid, unlimited:true, expires_at, privacy:zero_application_query_logs, auto_renew:false, and null allowance/count fields because paid query activity is not recorded. remaining is zero after exhaustion; used counts attempted charged calls and can exceed the limit. This is a point-in-time snapshot, not a reservation for concurrent requests. Quota UUIDs do not authenticate an account or grant upload ownership. Database failure returns a tool error with success:false,error,status:503; no JSON or caller identifier is returned.
name: get_quota
title: Inspect remaining daily quota
